# 14 August Fix-It at Northside: the short version

Getting in: level access from the main entrance. No steps.

When: Saturday 14 August, 10am to 12:30pm.

Where: Northside Community Centre, Main Hall.

Book through the Northside office. 40 places.

Bring your broken thing and its charger.

Please leave at home: microwaves, gas appliances, swollen batteries, e-bike and e-scooter batteries, and power tool batteries over 36 V.

Ask the Northside office: 555-0130.
